ms.promise:
There are four main building blocks or sofrware components of the CardanoJ Libraries to be build. 
・Serialization and deserialization for datum and redeemer
・Transaction builder that supports script transactions
・Automatic fee estimation for script transactions
・Stake delegation for funds locked in Plutus scripts
ms.criteria:
For each of the output following are made available
・CadanoJ source code 
・Documentation including readme file
・Unit Test Cases confirming test results. 

Additionally, a short video showing sample unit test case run to confirm the code is working.
ms.report:
CardanoJ is a library for Java developers to write off-chain code in Java, so they can write dApps faster.
Creating re-usable libraries is always a difficult task and it took us bit longer than we thought. We have worked hard in last two months doing some detailed R&D and development of building block for the CardanoJ.
Here are evidences.
CardanoJ GitHub Repository Link: It Contains code for all four main building block components of the CardanoJ. 
https://github.com/CardanoJ/cardanoJ
Documentation including readme file: The Readme file containing basic documentation about development completed so far and how to use the code.
https://github.com/CardanoJ/cardanoJ/blob/cardanoj-cli/README.md
GitHub repository link having Unit Test Cases: This is Part of the main CardanoJ repository and it have Unit Test Cases. 
https://github.com/CardanoJ/cardanoJ/tree/cardanoj-cli/src/test/java/com/cardanoJ
Video confirming Code is working:
It is a short video showing running code and confirming it is working. 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xklcwo6_GHk
This video link is also added at readme.md file at location https://github.com/CardanoJ/cardanoJ/blob/cardanoj-cli/README.md
This sets beginning, we are very excited and looking forward to work on the next set of deliverables like API Documentation and SDK developments.
